note: Pre-registration addendum 2 for the carry track, written and committed BEFORE the run through Monte-Neo block 10 (1450cc9). Not investment advice. Nothing from 2025-01-01 on is read: tables are cut at 2024-12-31. The earlier checks (first path and block 9) are recorded in strategy_lab/results/carry_E_newpath.md; validation is already contaminated (simulator rewritten after the first read, margin 50% chosen after 25% liquidated, yearly funding printed before pre-registration).

common.rule: carry_track E_btc_eth_slow signal per coin: mean funding of 30 days, enter > 0.0002/day, exit <= 0.00005, decisions weekly on calendar phase 0 (days since 2019-12-01 divisible by 7), weight 1/3 of equity per held coin (50% of equity deployed per coin with 50% margin), at most two coins held
common.perp_high: the Lab's perp day-high with the bad-tick cap (at most 10% above max(open, close))
common.volumes: spot_quote_volume and perp_quote_volume = daily volume x close, in USDT, per leg

collateral_policy_E.meaning: rebalance between spot and perp when the perp margin buffer falls below 25% of notional: top up to 1/leverage (50%) by selling spot; the transfer arrives one bar later; cost of selling spot / moving the margin per binance_costs
collateral_policy_E.cost_basis: spot side cost of ETHUSDT, the dearer of the two coins: VIP0 spot fee 10 bps + 3 bps spread (binance_costs.py)
collateral_policy_E.note: the Lab simulator itself tops up at 30% with no delay; this policy is stricter (smaller trigger, one-bar delay) and is the one tested

E.universe: BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT chosen by hand (the original candidate)

E_pit.meaning: the same signal with an ex-ante composition: on each weekly rebalance date the top 2 coins by perp quote volume over the previous 30 bars (strictly before the date), recomputed by the verifier; positions outside it are flat
E_pit.pool_note: the 12 coins of the Lab carry data; all alive over the sample, so the survivorship cap may stay (the verifier says so); delisted perps are not in the Lab data
E_pit.signal_detail: per-coin hold state evolves as in E regardless of membership; the weight is 1/3 x hold x in_universe, so a coin that leaves the universe is exited and, if it returns while the state is still hold, is held again
E_pit.costs_basis: fixed for all pool coins at the cost of the 5 bps spread class (XRP/ADA/SOL: fee 10/5 + 5), between BTC/ETH and the dear small coins; the verifier also tests doubled costs
E_pit.n_trials_note: E_pit is a new attempt: n_trials = 104 + 2016 + 45 + 1 = 2166 for E_pit; E stays at 2165

selection: no selection: both are reported whatever the outcome; no parameter is changed after seeing results
